internal.title: Incident Review: Accounting Service Kafka Consumer Lag
internal.body:
At 12:16 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for high Kafka consumer lag in the accounting service. Diagnosis identified a queue backlog issue linked to the kafkaQueueProblems flag being enabled. The flag was disabled at 12:36 UTC, which led to recovery and normalization of consumer lag metrics. No evidence of error injection was found in Kafka or accounting services. The incident was resolved by addressing the queue backlog condition promptly.

Timeline:
- 12:16:57 Alert received for KafkaConsumerLagHigh
- 12:36:47 Diagnosis confirmed queue backlog due to kafkaQueueProblems flag
- 12:36:54 Flag disabled after approval
- 12:36:54 Recovery verified with normalized consumer lag

Action taken:
- Disabled kafkaQueueProblems flag to clear backlog

This incident highlights the importance of monitoring and managing Kafka consumer lag and related flags to prevent service degradation.
